entities.name: André Abbal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: André Abbal (1876–1953) was a French sculptor. He was commissioned to work on several war memorials. He is best known as a pioneer of "Direct carving" and became known as "L'Apôtre de la Taille Directe".
